company_description: Assurant, Inc. provides protection services to connected devices, homes, and automobiles in North America, Latin America, Europe, and the Asia Pacific. It operates through Global Lifestyle and Global Housing segments. The Global Lifestyle segment offers mobile device solutions, and extended service contracts and related services for consumer electronics and appliances, and credit and other insurance products; and vehicle protection, commercial equipment protection, and other related services. The Global Housing segment provides lender-placed homeowners, manufactured housing, and flood insurance; renters insurance and other products; and voluntary manufactured housing, and condominium and homeowners insurance products. The company was formerly known as Fortis, Inc. and changed its name to Assurant, Inc. in February 2004. Assurant, Inc. was founded in 1892 and is headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia.

kpis.explanation: Montant total versé en dividendes par action sur l'année fiscale. Indicateur clé pour les investisseurs orientés revenus.
kpis.description: Historique 5 ans des dividendes par action déclarés (2021-2025).
kpis.explanation_en: Dividend Per Share — total dividends paid divided by shares outstanding.
kpis.signal_en: Shareholder returns growing, dividend policy supportive

kpis.explanation: Total annuel du cash redistribué aux actionnaires : dividendes versés + rachats d'actions (treasury stock).
kpis.description: Sur 2025 : dividendes + rachats d'actions cumulés en milliards $.
kpis.explanation_en: Capital Return — total cash returned to shareholders (dividends + buybacks).

kpis.explanation: Part du bénéfice net redistribuée en dividendes. Au-dessus de 80 % indique un dividende potentiellement non-soutenable.
kpis.description: Dividendes / résultat net sur 2025 (comptabilisé sur résultat net attribuable aux actionnaires).
kpis.explanation_en: Payout Ratio — dividends paid divided by net income.
kpis.signal_en: Dividend cut risk, monitor payout sustainability

kpis.explanation: Bénéfice net divisé par le nombre moyen d'actions diluées sur l'année fiscale. Permet de visualiser la capacité de la société à générer du résultat par action : base de calcul du Payout Ratio (DPS / EPS).
kpis.description: Historique 5 ans (2021-2025). Source : yfinance income statement (Diluted EPS).
kpis.explanation_en: Earnings Per Share — net income divided by shares outstanding.

revenue_by_customer_type.rationale: Assurant opère exclusivement en B2B2C (business-to-business-to-consumer), vendant des contrats d'assurance et services de protection via des partenaires de marques leaders (télécoms, constructeurs automobiles, prêteurs immobiliers). L'IA est mentionnée comme outil de support opérationnel (digital capabilities, data-driven solutions) mais ne constitue pas un produit ou service IA explicite commercialisé.
